Seat: `domain:spec#3`
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added (the dev measures the authorable-surface `api.json` baseline moving; the changeset gate confirms it)
File surface (added): `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts` (the `GET {basePath}/config` route passes its request to `getPublicConfig`, one line) and `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts` with its test (the same one line), plus an `@objectstack/hono` patch changeset. Reason: "resolved in the request language" needs the request's `accept-language`, and neither bare caller of `getPublicConfig()` passes a request today. Also the unreleased #31990 changeset gets a DELIBERATE CORRECTION edit, because the unreleased host option `developerEditionCreate` is removed, not tombstoned.
Seat rulings on the dev's three questions: (1) breach accepted as above; (2) shape accepted: non-flag key `features.organizationEditions`, entries `{ edition, label, hint, memberLimit? }`, with host option `AuthManagerOptions.organizationEditions(request)` checked against the spec schema when served, and nothing served when it is unset or empty; (3) `features.developerEditionCreate` stays as a flag derived from the served list (retiring it would narrow `requiresFeature` and leave the `@object-ui/auth` mirror stale), and `PublicAuthFeatureSurface` widens with `'shell'` because none of `crud` / `login` / `status` names a console form outside the login pages. The widened union rides on the same `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.
